name: Oba-san Janai, Onna Datta. ~Tonari no Yaoya no Oku-san to Koete wa Ikenai Natsu~
original_name: おばさんじゃない、女だった。〜隣の八百屋の奥さんと越えてはいけない夏〜
source:
Takato Mima, a college student, lost his father at a young age and has lived apart from his mother, who is often away from home due to work. It was Junko Sudou—the mother of his best friend, who runs the grocery store next door—who filled the void in Takato’s life, providing him with warm meals and affection.

Cheerful and caring, Junko was more like a foster mother to Takato than his own mother, and he had always cherished her as if she were family. But one day, triggered by the sweet, sensual scent emanating from her body and a chance glimpse of her voluptuous figure, his perception of her began to shift dramatically.

He finds himself desiring this mother-like figure as a woman—

Faced with a line she must never cross, Junko desperately tries to maintain her sanity. Yet the joy of being passionately desired by a young man, combined with her long-forgotten instincts as a “woman,” gradually begins to transform both her heart and body.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01705175.html]DLsite[/url]]
